row: The Pet Foster Network helps local animal rescue groups and shelters to recruit as many foster parents as possible by promoting the joys and needs of pet fostering in Chatham, Durham, Orange, and Wake counties, North Carolina, and by providing educational materials to develop successful foster programs.
